comparison.objective: Sharpen both faces of a knife on a whetstone and put it down safely.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated angle-controlled sliding contact across the blade length.
comparison.success_condition: At least three valid strokes and sufficient edge coverage per face; knife released edge-away.
comparison.reason: Both regulate tool contact, but sharpening tests sustained sliding at a prescribed angle; the candidate tests brief axial impacts, notch fracture, and fragment recovery.
